# slopsquat-guard (vendored)

The package check from [slopsquat-guard](https://github.com/GracjanFilipek/slopsquat-guard), copied here unchanged at commit `a9c8f1e` so Booardroom can run it without a separate install. MIT licensed, see `LICENSE`.

Booardroom registers `scripts/hook.mjs` as a `PreToolUse` hook on every agent run. To update, copy `plugins/slopsquat-guard/skills/npm-package-check/scripts` from the upstream repository over `scripts/`.
